profile.headline: SDE at Amazon Web Services
profile.summary: As a software developer, I intend to pursue a challenging and engaging career path. I enjoy problem solving and always approach challenges with enthusiasm.  I believe that a day I don’t learn something new is a wasted day, which is why I constantly seek to learn new things.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
● Collaborate with enterprise customers to understand their unique business requirements. Design and implement prototypes on AWS platform to meet the customer’s needs
● Developed automated failover solution for low latency workloads running at the in AWS Outposts. The solution ingests metrics from the customer about the state of their physical data center where the Outpost is deployed. Based on those metrics, the solution reacts to failure scenarios and redirects traffic to the closest LocalZone within seconds. This provides high reliability and minimizes latency during when the customer’s Outpost goes down.
● Create pipeline that ingests customer service conversations, performs speech to text on them, and has the text summarized by a Large Language Model running on AWS SageMaker Jumpstart. This saves the customer service workers time because they no longer have to type up a summary to provide to management. Also, management no longer has to deal with low quality or missing summaries, and is able to gain actionable insight into their customer service operation.
● Developed a OLTP and data visualization solution. Previously, the company had to respond to customer requests for data reports. This involved manually creating custom MariaDb queries that took hours to run as the indexes were not optimized for those queries. The turnaround on a custom report request was at least a week. To solve this, I set up data replication to AWS RedShift, and exposed the database via a QuickSight dashboard. Using AWS Cognito, each customer can log in to their own Quicksight dashboard, and run any query they want against their data. The queries are fast because RedShift is optimized for ad-hoc queries. No one at the company has to generate manual reports anymore, and the customer has an improved experience.

Technologies: Route 53, API Gateway, Lambda, Cloudwatch, SNS, SQS, Outposts, Redshift, DMS, RDS, QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, Terraform, S3, OpenSearch, Python, Typescript, Java

positions.description:
● Lead Active Directory and Identity Cloud team, lead daily scrum meetings, organized Jira sprints
